title: Pip's Drawing
text:
A drawing on sackcloth in charcoal: a house, a very large sun, a cat, and a tall figure with a hat full of candles.

Underneath, carefully: THIS IS ME AND MUM AND BISCUIT AND THE CANDLE MAN. THE CANDLE MAN IS NICE HE GIVES US LIGHT.

The tall figure has been scribbled over, hard, by a different hand.
